en.headline: Wong takes Hong Kong's first Asian Games men's singles tennis gold
en.dek: Coleman Wong beat Wu Yibing 6-2, 6-4 in Nagoya for the team's eighth gold of the Games, matching the previous edition.
body: Coleman Wong won Hong Kong's first Asian Games gold in men's singles tennis on Saturday, beating China's Wu Yibing 6-2, 6-4 in the final in Nagoya.

Wong, the top seed, broke in the fifth and seventh games of the opening set and again in the ninth game of the second, then served out with four aces, reports from the match said. The gold is Hong Kong's eighth of these Games, matching the team's tally from the previous Asian Games.

Organisers have said the winner can take a place in the men's singles at the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics if he remains inside the top 500 of the world rankings before 12 June 2028. Reports also said a gold at the Games qualifies an athlete for HK$1 million under the Jockey Club Elite Athletes Fund.

zh.headline: 黃澤林奪港隊首面亞運網球男單金牌
zh.dek: 黃澤林在名古屋決賽以6比2、6比4擊敗吳易昺，港隊今屆第八金，追平上屆金牌數目。
body: 香港網球手黃澤林周六在名古屋亞運男單決賽直落兩盤擊敗中國的吳易昺，為香港奪得史上首面亞運網球男子單打金牌。
頭號種子黃澤林以6比2、6比4勝出。賽事報道指，他在首盤第五及第七局破發，次盤第九局再破發，最後一局連發四記Ace收桿。這面金牌是港隊今屆第八金，追平上屆亞運的金牌數目。
賽會規定，勝方若能在2028年6月12日前維持世界排名500位以內，可取得2028年洛杉磯奧運男單入場券。報道亦指，亞運金牌運動員可按賽馬會優秀運動員獎勵計劃獲100萬港元。
